# Marque Changelog

Every released version of every Marque package, newest first. For the curated
story of which packages moved together and why, see
[RELEASES.md](RELEASES.md); for the full detail of any single release, follow
the package link.

*This file is generated by `bin/build-changelog` from the per-package
changelogs — edit those, not this.*

## 2026-09-03

- **[bloodhound 5.0.0](packages/bloodhound/CHANGELOG.md)** — Makes the announce log the durable source of truth for ratio, adds the reconciliation, rebuild and audit that make a wrong number detectable, and keeps swarm counts honest with an hourly reaper.
- **[cennad 4.0.0](packages/cennad/CHANGELOG.md)** — API read endpoints now require authentication by default; a public tracker opts out explicitly.
- **[disguise 4.1.0](packages/disguise/CHANGELOG.md)** — Enforces per-torrent restrictions for guests, and shows swarm counts.
- **[guise 4.1.0](packages/guise/CHANGELOG.md)** — Enforces per-torrent restrictions on detail pages and downloads, and shows swarm counts.
- **[hound 3.1.0](packages/hound/CHANGELOG.md)** — Records swarm counts on the announce path so a public catalogue can filter and sort on them.
- **[parley 2.1.1](packages/parley/CHANGELOG.md)** — Widens the `marque/trove` constraint to allow trove 4.x. No functional change.
- **[threepio 3.1.0](packages/threepio/CHANGELOG.md)** — Adds an optional durable fallback for a peer baseline Redis has lost, and fixes an unbounded recursion that crashed the process when removing an expired peer.
- **[trove 4.0.0](packages/trove/CHANGELOG.md)** — Adds per-torrent access control and swarm counts, and filters both in the listing.
- **[usarrs 6.1.1](packages/usarrs/CHANGELOG.md)** — Widens the `marque/trove` constraint to allow trove 4.x. No functional change.

## 2026-09-02

- **[bloodhound 4.1.0](packages/bloodhound/CHANGELOG.md)** — Adds an opt-in announce log for investigating cheating reports and settling disputed ratios.
- **[usarrs 6.1.0](packages/usarrs/CHANGELOG.md)** — Fixes a lockout where unverified users had no route to verify, leaving `verified` middleware unsatisfiable.

## 2026-09-01

- **[ise 1.0.1](packages/ise/CHANGELOG.md)** — Fixes a stray pre-rename `id-navigation` tag that broke every page using the shipped layout.
- **[parley 2.1.0](packages/parley/CHANGELOG.md)** — Adds off-by-default rate limiting for posts and replies; turn it on before any public deployment.
- **[usarrs 6.0.0](packages/usarrs/CHANGELOG.md)** — Requires Fortify; adds off-by-default two-factor auth and passkeys, plus a `manage_auth` escape hatch.

## 2026-08-26

- **[bloodhound 4.0.0](packages/bloodhound/CHANGELOG.md)** — Renames the tracker `passkey` column to `announce_key`, avoiding a collision with Laravel's WebAuthn passkeys.
- **[usarrs 5.0.0](packages/usarrs/CHANGELOG.md)** — Renames the profile page's `PasskeyManagement` component.

## 2026-08-20

- **[disguise 4.0.0](packages/disguise/CHANGELOG.md)** — Depends on `marque/ise` instead of the renamed `marque/id`.
- **[guise 4.0.0](packages/guise/CHANGELOG.md)** — Depends on `marque/ise` instead of the renamed `marque/id`.
- **[ise 1.0.0](packages/ise/CHANGELOG.md)** — First release under this name — the app shell and shared Blade components, replacing `marque/id`.
- **[parley 1.0.0](packages/parley/CHANGELOG.md)** — First release — polymorphic threaded discussion for torrent comments and forum-lite.
- **[parley 2.0.0](packages/parley/CHANGELOG.md)** — Depends on `marque/ise` instead of the renamed `marque/id`.
- **[usarrs 4.0.0](packages/usarrs/CHANGELOG.md)** — Depends on `marque/ise` instead of the renamed `marque/id`.

## 2026-08-15

- **[squidink 1.0.0](packages/squidink/CHANGELOG.md)** — First release — Markdown and BBCode in, HTML and plain text out, through one shared document model.
